components.label: Caller
components.responsibility: Invoke the documented API and retain returned outcomes.

components.label: Ring counter
components.responsibility: Route each second to its timestamp-tagged slot; hold the slot stripe while resetting epoch and incrementing count.

components.label: Injected clock
components.responsibility: Use an injected clock adapter with nondecreasing clamp and a visible rollback diagnostic; never trust request time for expiration.

components.label: Timestamp ring
components.responsibility: Index now modulo 300; slot contains epoch second and count, never count alone.

components.label: Slot stripe locks
components.responsibility: Lock the stripe covering the slot, replace stale tag/count with {now,0}, checked increment, then release.

components.label: Ordered stripe snapshot
components.responsibility: Acquire all stripes in ascending index, sample clock once, sum matching epochs, and release reverse order. Hit samples now only after its stripe lock is held.

components.label: Per-key admission gate
components.responsibility: tryAcquire takes all stripes in the same order and checks sum plus increments its current slot as one transition. Plain hit remains slot-striped.

components.label: Key lifecycle
components.responsibility: Use a capped key directory and reference pinning; reclaim idle keys only when their window is empty and no operation pins the entry.

components.label: Checked arithmetic
components.responsibility: Check per-slot increment and sum overflow before publishing mutation; report exhaustion rather than wrap negative.

components.label: Caller
components.responsibility: Invoke the documented API and retain returned outcomes.

components.label: Deque counter
components.responsibility: Store ascending timestamp buckets per key and expire from the head; serialize only operations for the same key.

components.label: Key mutex directory
components.responsibility: Use bounded striped directory lookup with pinned per-key entries, then serialize only that entry's state transitions.

components.label: Monotone key clock
components.responsibility: Sample the injected monotone clock while holding the key mutex; clamp regressions and keep diagnostic state.

components.label: Timestamp buckets
components.responsibility: Increment the tail bucket if its timestamp equals now, otherwise append one bucket; keep checked running total.

components.label: Head expiry
components.responsibility: Before any read/admission, pop while head.second <= now-300 and subtract each count exactly once.

components.label: Atomic decision
components.responsibility: Under the same key lock, expire then compare total to limit; on success add one hit before unlocking.

components.label: Idle-key reaper
components.responsibility: After expiration leaves empty deque, mark idle; directory removal checks entry identity and pin count. Live-key cap rejects rather than evicts active accounting.

components.label: Overflow and shutdown policy
components.responsibility: Only pop a bucket once under its owner lock, use checked totals, and stop admission on numeric exhaustion. Reinitialization is explicit.

requirements.text: Record concurrent hits without losing increments when a ring slot changes epoch; expire at the exact 300-second boundary.
Use granular hit-path synchronization and a consistent count snapshot policy.
Inject time and define clock rollback, overflow, per-key memory bounds and optional atomic check-and-admit.

problem.scope: Authored in-process exact integer-second counter and optional admission limiter. Compare striped timestamp-tagged 300-slot rings with per-key ordered timestamp queues. Count window at second now is [now-299,now]; timestamps <=now-300 expire. The injected nondecreasing clock defines time, not client timestamps. No cross-machine clock or distributed rate-limit guarantee.
